title: Replying to @The Wrong Cat Died #documentary #musicals #unknownnumber

classificationReason: Creator discusses multiple documentaries-turned-musicals (Grey Gardens, Hands on a Hardbody, How to Dance in Ohio, Queen of Versailles, Fyre Festival, etc.) and brainstorms future candidates. No single show is the primary focus; this is general commentary across many titles.
